items.exampleEn: He has a quirky sense of humor that not everyone understands.
items.exampleZh: 他的幽默感很古怪，不是每個人都懂。

items.exampleEn: Her face looked ghostly in the light of the phone.
items.exampleZh: 在手機的光照下，她的臉看起來像鬼一樣蒼白。

items.exampleEn: Tall, stately trees line both sides of the road.
items.exampleZh: 高大挺拔的樹木排列在道路兩旁。

items.exampleEn: I need a piece of elastic to fix my old skirt.
items.exampleZh: 我需要一條鬆緊帶來修我的舊裙子。

items.exampleEn: The idea had been latent in her mind for years.
items.exampleZh: 這個想法在她心裡潛藏了好幾年。

items.exampleEn: Because of its rarity, this stamp is worth a lot of money.
items.exampleZh: 因為稀有，這張郵票非常值錢。

items.exampleEn: The village school teaches only rudimentary math and reading.
items.exampleZh: 村裡的學校只教基本的數學和閱讀。

items.exampleEn: The versatility of this kitchen machine really surprised me.
items.exampleZh: 這台廚房機器的多功能真的讓我很驚訝。

items.sentenceEn: My knowledge of French is still only rudimentary.
items.sentenceZh: 我的法文還只懂一點基礎。

items.audioEn: A ghostly light appeared over the lake just before sunrise.
items.audioZh: 日出前，湖面上出現了一道幽幽的光。
items.questionZh: 日出前湖面上出現了什麼？

items.sentenceEn: Many people have latent talents that nobody has discovered.
items.sentenceZh: 很多人都有尚未被發掘的潛在天分。

items.sentenceEn: The waist of these trousers is elastic, so they are very comfortable.
items.sentenceZh: 這條褲子的腰部有彈性，所以穿起來很舒服。

items.stemEn: The old city hall is a ____ building that looks calm, grand, and serious.
items.stemZh: 舊市政廳是一棟莊嚴的建築，看起來沉穩、宏偉又嚴肅。

items.stemEn: Snow in this desert town is a ____; it happens about once every ten years.
items.stemZh: 在這個沙漠小鎮，下雪是很罕見的事，大約每十年才一次。

items.passageEn: On the edge of town stands a stately old house that once belonged to a famous writer. Today it is a small museum, and it is known for its quirky collection of hats, umbrellas, and hundreds of buttons. Visitors say the upstairs rooms feel almost ghostly, because the furniture has not moved for a hundred years. Even the antiquated light switches still work. One true rarity in the collection is a letter written by hand from the writer to his mother. The museum's guide, a former actor, shows great versatility: he sings, tells stories, and even plays the piano for visitors.
items.passageZh: 小鎮邊緣矗立著一棟宏偉的老宅，曾經屬於一位知名作家。如今它是一間小博物館，以古怪有趣的館藏聞名：帽子、雨傘，還有好幾百顆鈕扣。參觀者說樓上的房間幾乎有點陰森，因為傢俱已經一百年沒移動過了。就連老舊的電燈開關都還能用。館藏中一件真正的珍品，是那位作家親筆寫給母親的一封信。博物館的導覽員以前是演員，展現了多才多藝的一面：他會唱歌、說故事，甚至為參觀者彈鋼琴。

questions.questionZh: 這間博物館以什麼聞名？
options: 收藏作家寫過的所有小說

items.promptZh: 這份工作需要一些基本的電腦技能。
referenceEn: This job requires some rudimentary computer skills.
The job needs some rudimentary computer skills.
rubricZh: rudimentary 表示「基本的、初步的」（例如 rudimentary computer skills 等）

items.promptZh: 在這家熱門餐廳，有空位是很難得的事。
referenceEn: At this popular restaurant, an empty table is a rarity.
An empty table is a real rarity at this popular restaurant.
rubricZh: 「很難得的事」用 rarity（例如 is a rarity、a real rarity 等）
「空位」可寫，例如 an empty table、a free table、a free seat 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：「以收藏帽子、雨傘和好幾百顆鈕扣這種古怪有趣的收藏聞名」中「收藏」重複、句子不通順。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為「以古怪有趣的館藏聞名：帽子、雨傘，還有好幾百顆鈕扣」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項 complementary 跨課重複（本範圍 5 次）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: complementary 換成本課 quirky（與 calm, grand, and serious 矛盾）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：q14 干擾項 pale 一眼可排除且同單元重複
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: pale 換成 fusion（u03-l04 名詞，放得進 is a ____ 但語意不通）；保留字形相近的 rare

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長最終複審修正：混合詞性題只剩 1 個干擾項放得進空格（versatility 不可數，a versatility 不合文法）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: versatility 換成 predecessor（u02-l01，可數名詞，放得進 is a ____ 但語意不通）；保留字形相近的 rare

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（執行長釋義原則）：rudimentary 例句「The cabin had only rudimentary furniture: a bed and a chair.」示範的是次要義，第一義應為最常用義「基本的、初步的」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改寫為「The village school teaches only rudimentary math and reading.」示範第一義；釋義為「基本的、初步的；簡陋的」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：rudimentary 表示「基本的、初步的」（例如 rudimentary computer skills 等）／「需要」可寫，例如 require、need 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：rarity 表示「罕見的事物」，用法例如 is a rarity、a real rarity 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（rarity）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u04-l05-q17；目標字沿用 rarity
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「在這家熱門餐廳，有空位是很難得的事。」、hintWords ["rarity"]、referenceEn ["At this popular restaurant, an empty table is a rarity.","An empty table is a real rarity at this popular restaurant."]、rubricZh ["「很難得的事」用 rarity（例如 is a rarity、a real rarity 等）","「空位」可寫，例如 an empty table、a free table、a free seat 等"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 rarity 造一個句子，說說在你的生活中很少發生的事。」、referenceEn ["For me, a free weekend is a rarity these days.","Eating breakfast at home is a rarity in my busy week."]）
